prompt: Create a cinematic luxury editorial portrait of a stylish young Black man with medium-brown skin and high tied dreadlocks lounging on a white poolside chaise beside a bright turquoise swimming pool at a modern resort. He wears oversized reflective blue wraparound sunglasses with a sharp starburst glint, an open glossy navy-blue leather or vinyl jacket and matching loose pants, with exactly 3 large white star patches visible down the right sleeve. His bare chest is covered with layered diamond necklaces and pendants, diamond bracelets, and rings; add exactly 3 intense sparkle flares on the jewelry and sunglasses. He holds a black smartphone low in one hand while lifting the sunglasses with the other, looking cool and focused. Use a low, close, slightly wide-angle composition with his legs filling the lower left foreground, torso centered, head near the upper middle, and the pool stretching behind him. Background: sunlit teal water, soft-focus hedges, palm trunks, and modern architecture, shallow depth of field. Visual style: high-end fashion photography mixed with polished digital painting, hyper-detailed glossy fabric reflections, strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, saturated cyan-and-navy color palette, cinematic 16:9 aspect ratio, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影级的奢华时尚杂志人像，画面主体为 一位肤色中等、扎着高马尾脏辫的时尚黑人青年，他正慵懒地躺在现代度假村明亮绿松石色泳池旁的白色躺椅上。他佩戴着带有锐利星芒反光的超大号蓝色环绕式墨镜，身穿敞开的亮面海军蓝皮革或乙烯基夹克及配套宽松长裤，右袖上清晰可见 3 个白色大星形补丁。他赤裸的胸前叠戴着钻石项链和吊坠，佩戴着钻石手链和戒指；在珠宝和墨镜上添加 3 个强烈的闪光点。他一只手低垂拿着黑色智能手机，另一只手轻抬墨镜，神情酷飒且专注。采用低角度、近景、略带广角构图，双腿填充左下前景，躯干居中，头部位于中上方，泳池向后延伸。背景：阳光下的青色水面、虚化的绿篱、棕榈树干和现代建筑，浅景深。视觉风格：高端时尚摄影与精致数字绘画相结合，超细节的亮面织物反光，强烈的正午阳光，清晰的阴影，饱和的青色与海军蓝配色，电影级 16:9 画幅，无文字，无水印。
